text:
elaine: Planning RBAC change: rotate service-account role bindings for the analytics pipeline tomorrow 2026-03-22 06:00 UTC. Need audit artifacts and KMS access proof for SOC 2 evidence pack. Tagging infra + ops.

 tom: On it. Which exact roles are we changing? IAM role for the pipeline-runner? k8s ClusterRoleBinding?

 maria: Confirming: this will update AWS IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/analytics-runner and k8s clusterrolebinding analytics-runner-binding in prod clusters. GCP service accounts are NOT part of this change.

 elaine: Correct. We will also rekey the KMS alias used to wrap exported artifacts: alias/audit-exports. Rotation is scheduled to ensure ciphertexts remain verifiable.

 auditor_steph: For evidence, we need: change timeline, PR/commit IDs, who approved, CloudTrail events showing AssumeRole/STS, KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events, K8s audit logs showing RBAC change, and a signed manifest listing exported files. Retention proof: where logs live and retention policy.

 tom: Commands I'll run to produce the artifacts (sharing here so it's reproducible):
 ```bash
 # CloudTrail events for IAM role changes
 aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue="analytics-runner" --start-time 2026-03-21T05:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-22T07:00:00Z > ct-events.json
 
 # KMS usage around rotation
 aws cloudwatch logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/kms/alias/audit-exports" --start-time 1711700000000 --end-time 1711703600000 > kms-events.json
 
 # Kubernetes audit (sample path)
 gsutil cp gs://redwood-cluster-audit/prod/2026-03-22/audit.log ./k8s-audit.log
 
 tar -czf evidence-3555551234.tar.gz ct-events.json kms-events.json k8s-audit.log manifest.json
 aws s3 cp evidence-3555551234.tar.gz s3://redwood-audit/3555551234/
 ```

 maria: I'll extract the k8s audit lines for the ClusterRoleBinding change and sanitize them (removed IPs/user-agent) before upload. Example sanitized line:
 ```
 {"kind":"Event","verb":"patch","user":"elaine","objectRef":{"resource":"clusterrolebindings","name":"analytics-runner-binding"},"timestamp":"2026-03-22T06:01:12Z"}
 ```

 ryan: Export job kicked off. s3 path: s3://redwood-audit/3555551234/evidence-3555551234.tar.gz. I'm also generating a manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and will sign it with the security key.

 ci-bot: export-job-3555551234 started by ryan — status: running :rocket: 

 elaine: Note on KMS: We'll include the CloudWatch event that shows KeyRotationCompleted and the CMK arn. For proofs, we will include the KMS key metadata (creation date, key state) and a signed note of the key alias rotation plan.

 auditor_steph: Quick Q: Are there any intermediate rollbacks or emergency admin overrides during the window? We need the service-account session tokens and the related STS AssumeRole logs if there were.

 maria: No rollbacks. We have one short deployment restart at 06:05 UTC (planned) — no privilege escalations. I pulled STS logs; here's a sample CloudTrail entry (sanitized):
 ```
 {"eventTime":"2026-03-22T06:00:45Z","eventName":"AssumeRole","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:user/elaine"},"requestParameters":{"roleArn":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/analytics-runner"}}
 ```

 elaine: I'll upload the signed manifest and a GPG-signed note with the key fingerprint. Also will DM the KMS-encrypted envelope key to the auditor.

 auditor_steph: Perfect — once I have the manifest, signed note, and CloudTrail + KMS logs (with clear filenames and checksums) I can mark the control as satisfied. Also please add a short README in the bundle describing sanitization steps.

 tom: Adding README.md to the tarball with steps: how artifacts were collected, fields redacted, retention policy pointer (confluence: /security/log-retention). I'll include the commit hash for the infra change: 9f3b2a1.

 elaine: Thanks — I'll close the loop after upload and post the final link here. :white_check_mark:

 ryan: upload complete — s3://redwood-audit/3555551234/evidence-3555551234.tar.gz (manifest.json + manifest.sig + README.md + ct-events.json + kms-events.json + k8s-audit.log)

 auditor_steph: Got it, I'll start review now. If I need anything else I'll ping here. Thanks everyone :pray:
